verdict.rationale: Pipelines and assets are defined as plain Python code that you own (dagster-docs-1, dagster-docs-26), and there is a documented open-source Docker deployment you can self-host (dagster-docs-12). Together these imply low lock-in and an easy exit, but the pack never documents an actual data-export capability. missing for 10: a documented export of run history, asset metadata and event logs in open formats, a Dagster+ data-export or offboarding path, and independent confirmation that migrating off is practical.
